name: Springfield (Missouri, United States)
description: Light blue field with a white horizontal stripe below the centre, charged with a black eight-pointed star outlined in white and three small white stars, for Springfield as the Queen City of the Ozarks and its three founding communities.
history: Springfield is the third most populous city in Missouri and the county seat of Greene County. A flag made official in 1938 resembled that of St. Louis; in 2017 the Springfield Flag Movement proposed a new design, which the city council voted 7–2 to adopt on 10 January 2022 and which became official on 1 March 2022.
